input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: Section 14.10 is one-directional: it restricts only Customer's assignments (consent, not unreasonably withheld, with a successor carve-out) while leaving IBM entirely free to assign the Agreement to anyone, including a competitor, without our consent. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual successor right on written notice and consent (not unreasonably withheld) for every other assignment by either party. No change-of-control clause exists anywhere in the document, so IBM has no termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, and the sole material gap is the asymmetry. We have therefore made the smallest conforming edit to the two operative sentences, targeting the fallback level and leaving the anti-circumvention and continuing-liability sentences untouched.

mappings.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
A successor assignment requires written notice.
Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.

proposal.summary: Make assignment mutual: successor assignments on written notice, other assignments by consent not unreasonably withheld.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.10 restricts only our assignments while leaving IBM free to assign to anyone. We have made the clause mutual at our fallback position: either party may assign to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition on written notice, and any other assignment requires the other party's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Neither party will assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may assign this Agreement, upon written notice to the other party, to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
